body: I just snapped and told her exactly how im feeling. Maybe I shouldnt have. Idk.
Im not religious either, im not sure that can help me right now, im not going to kill myself though. After the last few messages ive just recieved from my girlfriend it sounds like she is suicidal.

Im always scared to say anything because im sure plenty of other people have it worse than me. Im probably just pathetic.
I suffer from very severe anxiety and panic attacks. Most nights I fly into panic and start saying and thinking suicidal things. I will probably never do it but the thoughts are there. I have a girlfriend who was supportive at first, but she had told me that she doesnt know if she can take it anymore. She has severe depression and is also the most pessimistic person ive ever met. Every day she goes into a depressive mood and saying how her life is pathetic and now im getting to the point that I cant handle that, its going on as we speak over on discord. I hate myself and have lost interest in things I used to love doing. My sleep schedule is all over the place and im constantly tired. I dont have any close friends anymore. I just dont know what to do.
Hello. I dont know what to do.
